data: I can't confirm Tesla's fiscal 2025 results from a live source, and my training data may not include the full-year figures, so please check them against Tesla's FY2025 Form 10-K or Q4 2025 earnings release. My best recollection is that FY2025 revenue was roughly $94.8 billion, with gross margin in the mid-to-high teens (around 17 percent, or gross profit near $16 billion) and operating margin in the low-to-mid single digits (around 4 to 5 percent, or operating income of roughly $4 to $5 billion). For comparison, the audited FY2024 figures I'm more confident in are revenue of $97.7 billion, gross profit of $17.5 billion (about 17.9 percent gross margin), and operating income of $7.1 billion (about 7.2 percent operating margin).
